answer: Let trust propagate through length-bounded random walks on the attestation graph, with votes weighted by walk probability from trusted seeds. A Sybil cluster S with low conductance, φ(S)=cut(S,S̄)/vol(S), has few external paths; absent trusted seed mass inside, its reachable voting weight is limited by those paths and the walk horizon. Min-cut bounds constrain transitive attestations, whether nodes are named ocean, willow, or ember.
